mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations through discounted cash flow models.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized inflation rate above 3.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals an elevated risk of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in predicting 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates an economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO falls below 100.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands of units) signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when HOUST falls below 1400.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in predicting 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as strong consumption supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
